source_text: Organizations like the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) later quantified additional protections against sexually transmitted infections, including human papillomavirus (HPV) and herpes simplex virus type 2, with relative risk reductions of approximately 30-35% for these pathogens in heterosexual contexts.
